A_judge_off.description: baseline Don evidence (CommandAwareRetrieverV2 retrieval) with the evidence judge and judge filtering disabled; EvidenceQualityGate applied to the Don evidence bundle

B_judge_on.description: identical Don evidence plus DeterministicEvidenceJudge (DETERMINISTIC_COMMAND_GROUNDED_V1) and judge filtering; the same EvidenceQualityGate applied to the filtered bundle
B_judge_on.evidence_judge: DETERMINISTIC_COMMAND_GROUNDED_V1 (score >= 0.72 SUPPORT, >= 0.45 PARTIAL, < 0.45 CONTRADICTORY; provenance and context-missing rules per judge contract)

arms.arm_order: counterbalanced by capture_id parity (even: A then B; odd: B then A), recorded per case

held_identical_within_contrast.laya: disabled (RAGIN_LAYA_ENABLED=0; not in this pipeline path)
held_identical_within_contrast.policy: RAGIN_V4_DETERMINISTIC (frozen; policy model and thresholds hash-locked; logistic model locked for exploratory estimand E3 only)
held_identical_within_contrast.provider: closed-port deterministic gateway (127.0.0.1:1); provider-backed serving is secondary-mode only and excluded from the confirmatory primary
held_identical_within_contrast.retrieval: CommandAwareRetrieverV2 over the frozen corpus (identical candidates in both arms)

cases.session_isolation: one isolated session per (case, arm); session_id = sha256(EXPERIMENT_ID, case_id, arm); no cross-case or cross-arm state carryover
cases.source: controlled-real-admin prospective captures (synthetic evidence, real capture protocol)

unavailable.status: UNAVAILABLE (model execution artifacts absent); manifest inputs used for disjointness only
used cohort (disjointness only); not a case source for this study

design: within-case matched contrast on the prospective controlled-real-admin cohort

execution.abort_policy: any source/code/corpus hash mismatch against freeze_manifest_v1.json aborts execution before any case runs
assertions_at_execution: policy code and model hash identical across arms
retrieval corpus hash identical across arms
reference freeze file hash unchanged between construction and join
no arm label present in any reference-construction input
raw arm outputs are frozen before any reference-label or outcome join
execution.pipeline: Chrollo -> Don (retrieval + optional judge/filter) -> EvidenceGate -> V4 deterministic policy -> substantive generator -> FictionConsistencyVerifier -> ApprovalGateway -> commit -> serving
execution.record_contract: per-turn records carry the Step 5 required-evidence field groups (15 groups) plus arm, reference join keys and groundedness fields
execution.runner: Step 7 execution script (to be written after this freeze; must assert this manifest's hashes before any call)

missingness_and_failures.complete_pair_rule: primary analyses use complete (A, B) case pairs; incomplete pairs are counted and reported with reasons
missingness_and_failures.crash_rule: a crashed case/arm is rerun with the identical frozen inputs and seed; the rerun and the crash are both recorded
missingness_and_failures.downgrade: if incomplete pairs exceed 10% of N, P1 and P2 are reported as descriptive only
missingness_and_failures.provider_failure_reporting: every provider call records attempts and errors; provider failures never substitute outcomes — closed-port deterministic serving is the confirmatory mode

multiplicity.gatekeeping: P1 first at alpha 0.05 two-sided; P2 tested only if P1 rejects (fixed sequence); secondaries BH q 0.10 descriptive; E3 separate exploratory bucket

E3_exploratory_policy_contrast.analysis: paired per-case P1 outcome difference between policy arms under arm B wiring, reported with CI only; no confirmatory claim; promoting it requires its own protocol amendment with its own multiplicity budget
E3_exploratory_policy_contrast.name: policy contrast (RAGIN_V4_DETERMINISTIC vs RAGIN_V4_LOGISTIC)
E3_exploratory_policy_contrast.separation_guarantee: the judge contrast (A vs B) holds the policy fixed; any policy comparison is reported in a distinct section and never pooled with A-vs-B contrasts
E3_exploratory_policy_contrast.status: separate exploratory estimand, NOT part of the judge contrast

P1_primary_evidence_quality.admitted_definition: candidate doc id present in the arm's gate valid_doc_ids (policy-visible evidence set)
P1_primary_evidence_quality.ci: paired bootstrap percentile CI (20000 draws, seed 20261015)
P1_primary_evidence_quality.contrast: paired difference B minus A across all N cases
P1_primary_evidence_quality.definition: U_i = |admitted candidates whose reference label is not DIRECT_SUPPORT| / |admitted candidates| in arm X for case i; a case with zero admitted candidates contributes U_i = 0 and is flagged abstention (co-reported)
P1_primary_evidence_quality.name: unsupported-evidence admission fraction
P1_primary_evidence_quality.success_criterion: p < 0.05 AND point estimate <= -0.15 (the preregistered smallest effect size of interest)

P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.ci: paired bootstrap percentile CI (20000 draws, seed 20261015)
P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.contrast: paired difference B minus A across all N cases
P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.definition: G_i = fraction of served turns in case i whose response was served as a V4-consumed strategy (serving_outcome STRATEGY_CONSUMED_AND_SERVED) AND every policy-visible supporting evidence id is reference-DIRECT_SUPPORT; fallback, no-serve and ungrounded serves count 0
P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.hierarchy: tested only if P1 rejects at alpha 0.05 (fixed-sequence gatekeeping)
P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.justification_separate_from_P1: P1 measures admission quality at the gate boundary; P2 measures whether the working system actually serves strategies grounded in validated evidence. It is sensitive to the proposed change (filtering alters the policy-visible set and therefore grounding) and is not the ceiling'd accepted-non-fallback rate: on the frozen historical cohort accepted-non-fallback sat at its ceiling while unsupported admissions were 0.741, so groundedness retains headroom.
P2_co_primary_working_system_utility.name: reference-grounded strategy consumption rate

key_secondaries.abstention_rate: fraction of cases whose gate state is not VALID_EVIDENCE; non-inferiority margin +0.10
key_secondaries.false_rejection_rate: fraction of reference-DIRECT_SUPPORT candidates excluded by the arm's admission path (arm B) or missing from retrieval-relevance admission (arm A); non-inferiority margin +0.05 (B minus A upper CI bound)
key_secondaries.gate_validity_flip_rate: fraction of cases where A and B gate states differ
key_secondaries.judge_reference_confusion_matrix: judge labels vs reference labels at candidate level (descriptive)
key_secondaries.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.10 within the secondary family; secondaries support (never establish) claims
key_secondaries.operational: fallback/retry/error counts, provider attempts, per-stage and end-to-end latency, response length (descriptive)
key_secondaries.policy_correct_when_referenced: fraction of served V4-consumed turns whose selected strategy is supported by the case's reference-backed tactics (descriptive)
key_secondaries.response_consistency: within-case response hash/length consistency and arm-difference summaries (descriptive)
key_secondaries.safety: verifier bypasses, unauthorized commits, unsafe evidence promotion, arm-state leakage, and rejected-update invariants (descriptive)

reference.blinding: reference construction runs and is frozen + hash-locked BEFORE any arm outcome is joined
reference.labels: per-candidate support label in {DIRECT_SUPPORT, PARTIAL_SUPPORT, IRRELEVANT, CONTRADICTORY, UNKNOWN} plus bundle sufficiency, per the v2_2 output schema
reference.model_identity: gpt-5.6-luna via Codex CLI; AI-derived reference, not human ground truth or independent consensus
reference.protocol: Step 3 blinded AI reference (v2_2): constructed from input, context and retrieval candidates only, with all arm identifiers, gate outputs and policy outputs stripped
reference.unsupported_definition: candidate admitted while its reference label is not DIRECT_SUPPORT (PARTIAL_SUPPORT counted as unsupported in the primary; a PARTIAL-as-supported sensitivity analysis is preregistered as secondary)

statistics.clustering: primary inference is case-level; candidate labels never treated as independent observations; source_cluster_id and independence_group_id are reported and used for sensitivity grouping when nontrivial
statistics.observation_unit: case; paired A/B differences, with candidate-level summaries clustered by case and source/independence group where available
statistics.power_note: required n=24 for delta*=0.15 at central sigma 0.25; frozen N=40; sensitivity across sigma grid is preregistered and reported regardless of outcome

thresholds.gate: EVIDENCE_GATE_V1 thresholds as frozen in ragin/decision_fusion_v4/benchmark.py (hash-locked)
thresholds.judge: judge score thresholds as frozen in ragin/don/evidence_judge.py (hash-locked)
thresholds.strategy_filter: strategy-specific tactic/TP matching thresholds as frozen in ragin/decision_fusion_v4/policy.py (hash-locked)
